name: temple_of_ahnqiraj
notes: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj, 40 players (map 531). The packs are the world database's spawns of 2026-09-12 (542 spawns, 41 entries) merged by the raid pull rule (one floor |dz| <= 4, chaining within 15 yd with a server walk of at most 2.2 x the line plus 8 yd, 16 units at most, a pack's reach absorbing lone spawns, radius farthest unit + 5 capped at 35); a creature group, a patrol or a boss is never merged into trash. The legs follow the rooms and the spiral of the temple.

Bosses in route order: Skeram, the Silithid Royalty (Vem, Kri, Yauj as one boss step), Sartura, Fankriss, Viscidus, Huhuran, the Twin Emperors (Vek'nilash first, Vek'lor last) and C'Thun; Ouro is the optional last leg. Doors are waited on after the kill that opens them (180636 after Skeram, 180634 after Huhuran, 180635 after the Twins), from instance_temple_of_ahnqiraj.cpp SetData.

Not in any pull: the Master's Eye (15963, spawned for the Twins' dialogue and despawned after it), the Beetle (15475, level 1), the C'Thun Portal (15896), the Ouro Spawner (15957, the Ouro leg's trigger), and the six friendly NPCs (Merithra, Caelestrasz, Arygos, Andorgos, Kandrostrasz, Vethsera: faction 35). They are in every leg's skip list.

C'Thun's chamber is a navmesh island on map 531: no server path reaches it from the corridor behind the Twins (the corridor's last reachable point is z -25) or from the upper terrace (z 53-63), so the boss stand is marked needs_walk and the mapping walk (B2) has to find the ramp; C'Thun's phase 2 (the stomach, area triggers 4033/4034/4036) is a blocker beyond phase 1.

The world buffs are disabled inside AQ40 on Turtle, and the community's AQ40 results are mixed: Skeram and Huhuran killed, Fankriss 10-20 % on good pulls, Sartura and the Twins wipe, C'Thun phase 1 only (waterys419, #1285/#1264). Most bosses need a playground patch that is not in dev: see the prep report's per-boss list.

Not in the rows: the entrance and teleports, the level band, the raid size, the leg skip lists, the patrol blocks and the wait_for's own condition beside the Ouro spawner (the run leader's rows carry no unit wait).

legs.name: entrance
notes: The upper terrace (z 118-153): the eight Anubisath Sentinels and the three Obsidian Eradicators, plus the Vekniss Guardian pair and the Qiraji Brainwasher of the terrace above Skeram's room. The instance removes the Sentinels and Eradicators once Skeram is DONE.

legs.name: skeram

wait_for.fail_text: Skeram is dead but the instance did not open the gate 180636 above his room: the descent to the Silithid Royalty stays shut.

notes: The Prophet Skeram: a 28 yd aggro radius (boss_skeram.cpp MoveInLineOfSight); he splits into two images at 75/50/25 % (spell 747) and one raider is mind-controlled (True Fulfillment). After his death the instance opens the gate 180636 at -8429.6 2048.8 153.3 (DoOpenDoor on TYPE_SKERAM DONE): the leg waits for it before the descent.

legs.name: silithid
notes: The long descent from Skeram's gate to the Silithid Royalty's room (z 0 to -4): Vekniss Guardians, Warriors and Qiraji Brainwashers. Vem has a 60 yd aggro radius and Kri and Yauj 30 yd (boss_bug_trio.cpp); the three are one boss step because each of the three must die and the last two devour the first (instance TYPE_BUG_TRIO SPECIAL). Kill Kri and Yauj first: the draft's order.

legs.name: sartura
notes: Battleguard Sartura and her three royal guards (creature group 87648). Area trigger 4052 at the arena puts her in combat with the zone when a player enters (instance DoHandleTempleAreaTrigger), so the first pull is the entrance itself; her Cleave 25174 is a frontal (ai_boss_tactic 'behind').

legs.name: fankriss
notes: The Vekniss hive below the Sartura arena: 146 Vekniss Drones and 6 Vekniss Soldiers in merged 16-unit packs, then Fankriss. His web entangles and spawns Vekniss Hatchlings; he pulls any player above z -70 (his UpdateAI), so the corridor packs come first.

legs.name: viscidus
notes: Viscidus: a 95 yd aggro radius (boss_viscidus.cpp MoveInLineOfSight), and the fight needs frost hits to freeze him (the community's frost weapons and Frost Oil). No trash of his own in the world data.

legs.name: huhuran

wait_for.fail_text: Huhuran is dead but the instance did not open the Twin Emperors' entry door 180634: the Twins' hall stays shut.

notes: The Huhuran wing: Vekniss Wasps, Stingers, Lashers and Hive Crawlers in their creature groups, then Huhuran (80 yd aggro). At 30 % she enrages and stings the closest targets (spell 26068/26180). Her death opens the Twins' door 180634 at -8929.6 1344.4 -104.2 (TYPE_HUHURAN DONE), and the leg waits for it.

legs.name: twins

wait_for.fail_text: The Twin Emperors are dead but the instance did not open the exit door 180635: C'Thun's corridor stays shut.

notes: The Qiraji Scarabs and Scorpions and the Anubisath Defenders of the Twin Emperors' hall (the instance removes them once the Twins are DONE), then the two Emperors as one boss step: Vek'nilash (15275) first, Vek'lor (15276) last. They share one health pool, teleport every 30-40 s and heal each other (7393); both have a 50 yd pull range and a z tolerance of 7 yd. Their Aggro closes the entry door 180634 again and their death opens the exit door 180635 at -9016.4 1330.7 -104.2 (TYPE_TWINS DONE), which the leg waits for. Area trigger 4047 starts their intro dialogue, not a fight.

legs.name: cthun
notes: The C'Thun corridor behind the Twins' exit door: Qiraji Mindslayers, Slayers, Champions, Anubisath Warders and Obsidian Nullifiers (4 of the Nullifiers are linked to Warders, creature_linking flag 3), then C'Thun. BLOCKER: map 531's navmesh does not join the corridor to C'Thun's chamber (the server path from the corridor ends at z -25 and from the upper terrace at z 53-63; C'Thun's platform at -8577.3 1986.9 100.4 is an island on the mesh). The boss stand is unverified (needs_walk) and the mapping walk must find the ramp.

legs.name: ouro
notes: Ouro, optional and last: Ouro (15517) has no spawn row. The Ouro Spawner (15957) at -9188 2092 -64 summons him (spell 26061) when a non-GM player stands within 25 yd, and he enters combat with the zone. The leg walks to a stand within 25 yd of the spawner and its boss is a hold on instance data 8 (TYPE_OURO, DONE on Ouro's death, boss_ouro.cpp JustDied; a FAIL respawns the spawner). His Sand Blast (26102) is a frontal cone and resets the hit target's threat (SpellHitTarget).
